items.title: Announcing the first Distributed E-Maj version.
items.summary: We are very glad to announce the Distributed E-Maj 0.9.1 version.Distributed E-Maj is an add-on to the E-Maj solution that brings the capability to revert data changes recorded on several databases to a common stable state in a consistent manner.This is the first released version. Thus, it is delivered for test purpose only.Distributed E-Maj 0.9.1 is compatible with E-Maj 5.0.1 and supports 14 to 19 PostgreSQL versions.The full documentation is available on line. The core extension is available at pgxn.org for installation or github.org for development.As a reminder, E-Maj is a "Change Data Capture" solution offering multiple ways to use tracked changes: consultation, statistics, replay, and above all rollback (E-Maj rollback) to a stable state (Mark) of predefined sets of database tables (Table Groups), allowing your data to "travel through time" in an optimized and consistent way. Distributed E-Maj extends the concept of a "Mark" and the "E-Maj Rollback" to table groups spread across multiple databases.Any feedback is welcome !
